facts.text: The user asked for 3 unique Unity game ideas.
The user wants the games to mix several popular top 250 grossing iOS mobile game mechanics.
The user wants the game to be extremely popular and profitable for the company owner.
The user provided a first game idea named Rush Royale.
The user described Rush Royale as having a tower defense mechanic.
The user described Rush Royale as having a card game mechanic.
The user said the player retention angle for the first idea includes player vs player, achievements, and leaderboards.
The user said the monetization model(s) for the first idea include gacha and lootboxes.

events.text: User requested regeneration of ideas after the first set of ideas.
